inputs_used: Apify web-search and web-fetch 2026-11-11: astirofparos.gr (home, weddings, conferences-events, luxury-accommodation), weddingparos.gr, aktiresortparos.gr/restaurant, parosresort.com (home, weddings-events), monastiri-paros.gr/paros-events-planning, lillyresidence.gr, parosagnanti.gr, calmehotelparos.com, parilio.com (empty, then timeout), portoparos.gr and cosmehotel.com (timeouts)

facts.claim: Astir of Paros describes itself as a five-star hotel 'only a breath away from the quaint village of Naoussa'; its structured address is Kolymbithres, Naoussa, Paros 84 401. Accommodation pages listed: Executive Suites, Junior Sea View Suites, Premium Suites, Junior Suites and Interconnecting Junior Suites. Total room count not stated on the home page read.

Astir of Paros has its own Weddings page ('Dream Wedding in Paros'), saying the complex faces the Aegean Sea and offers 'an once-in-a-lifetime experience for a cherished wedding ceremony and a memorable reception', with the executive chef and team, decoration and 'personalized services'. The page (last modified 5 November 2018) states no capacity, ceremony locations, ceremony types or exclusive use.
Astir of Paros site navigation also lists an Art Gallery, Conferences & Events, Dining & Bars and Experiences pages, alongside Weddings.

Astir of Paros' Conferences & Events page says its Venus Conference Hall has 'a sitting capacity of 130 delegates' (conference seating, not a stated wedding capacity). Page last modified 5 November 2018.
facts.conflicts: Only capacity figure on the site is for conference seating; no wedding reception or ceremony capacity is published.

facts.claim: FAILURE: parilio.com home page fetched live returned an empty 114-byte document (no title, no links); Parilio could not be verified as a wedding venue from its own site.
FAILURE: portoparos.gr and cosmehotel.com (guessed official domains for Porto Paros and Cosme) both timed out after 60 seconds on a live fetch; neither verified. Not retried.

Akti Resort (own site weddingparos.gr) describes itself as a 'traditional Cycladic complex' within walking distance of Kolymbithres beach, 2.5 km from the fishing village of Naoussa, in the northwest of Paros, with a panoramic view of the bay of Naoussa. Address given as Naoussa, GR-84401 Paros.

Akti Resort says its social event reception hall hosts weddings, christenings and birthdays; the hall is 'situated next to the pool', has a panoramic view of the bay of Naoussa and can 'accommodate up to 350 guests'. It offers a menu of traditional Parian dishes with wine of its own production, plus 'free organisational consulting, without any commission' for suppliers such as photographer, florist and decorations. The site describes receptions; it does not state ceremony locations or ceremony types.

Akti Resort offers seven fully equipped apartments (double, triple or four beds) 'just 10 meters away from the sea', a pool and pool bar, and the family-run Restaurant 'Spiros', founded by the Vionis family (first taverna in Naoussa in 1966; reception area opened 2008). Exclusive use not stated. The site also shows room rates and template placeholder text, so it appears not recently maintained; rates not recorded here.
facts.conflicts: Page carries a leftover 'Our Services' block (golf course, pizza delivery) that does not match the property, and two different emails (info@weddingparos.gr and info@akti-studios.gr); treat the page as dated. Also says 'More info at www.aktiresortparos.gr' (not read).

facts.claim: FAILURE: Lilly Residence (Naoussa) official site navigation, read live, lists Stay, Facilities, Experiences, Location and suites but no weddings or events page; not verified as a wedding venue.

OUT OF AREA (lead for batch B): Paros Agnanti Resort & Spa's own site gives its address as Krios Beach, Parikia 84400 (five-star) and its navigation lists an Events page; it is on the Parikia side, not Naoussa and the north, so not assessed in batch A.

Astir of Paros says the hotel 'comprises 46 suites of 2-4 persons (4 executive and 42 junior ones) and 11 double rooms', surrounded by lush tropical gardens with views over the Kolymbithres bay; renovated completely in 2018, with Naxos white marble bathrooms and verandas or balconies over 'the golf course and the shimmering blue sea'. Interiors display works from the owners' private art collection.
FAILURE: a rendered (browser) fetch of parilio.com timed out after 60 seconds, following the empty plain fetch in fact_05. Parilio not verified; not retried again.

Monastiri Beach Bar & Restaurant's own Weddings page says it sits within Paros Park, 'steps away from the historic Monastiri of Saint Ioannis Detis', 'just a 10-minute drive from Naoussa', reachable by road or by sea thanks to its dock. Couples can exchange vows 'on the sandy beach' or host a reception in the restaurant; event spaces listed are the amphitheatre, restaurant, lounge and beach deck. A wedding brochure is offered for download (not read).

Monastiri says its 'Archilochos' amphitheatre, built into the natural stone of the slope, 'can seat up to 800 guests comfortably' (stated in the corporate section). It also hosts pre and post-wedding parties with a stage and beach. Monastiri is a beach bar and restaurant: no accommodation is offered on the page read; wedding capacity for the restaurant or beach and exclusive use are not stated.
facts.conflicts: 800 is the amphitheatre seating figure given for corporate events, not a wedding capacity.

facts.claim: Anemoi Paros Hotel Resort (anemoiresort.gr, redirects to parosresort.com) says it is 'within a small distance from the village of Naoussa', overlooking Naoussa bay, and 'comprises eight apartments and studios, hosting from 2 to 6 people' in traditional Cycladic style, with an outdoor pool and Jacuzzi. Its Weddings section says the small Chapel of St. John, built in traditional Cycladic architecture, is on the premises and suits a wedding ceremony or a baptism. Capacity and exclusive use not stated on the home page read.
facts.conflicts: Home page says 'eight apartments and studios' but lists eight room types (one Executive Suite for up to 8 persons), so the count may be of types, not units; check before stating a room count.

facts.claim: OUT OF AREA (lead for batch C): Calme Boutique Hotel's own site (calme.gr redirects to calmehotelparos.com) gives its address as Chryssi Akti, Drios, describes itself as adults only, and search-result navigation shows 'Symbolic Weddings', 'Renewal of Vows' and 'Wedding Proposals' pages (not read). Not assessed in batch A.

Akti Paros's current site (aktiresortparos.gr, Venue Hall page) says it hosts 'weddings and baptisms', has a private pool overlooking the bay of Naoussa with the sea 'just a few meters from the pool area', and a space with unobstructed views of the bay 'able to accommodate up to 350 guests', with a traditional Parian menu; guests can book rooms at the property. Confirms the 350 figure in fact_08.

Anemoi's Weddings & Events page says the ceremony can take place in the small Chapel of St. John on the premises, after which staff organise a reception 'in our beautiful area by the swimming pool, with the deep blue of the Aegean Sea in the background'. No guest capacity or exclusive use is stated. The wording does not name a ceremony type, so whether religious ceremonies can be held in the chapel is not confirmed.

insider_details.detail: Kolymbithres has two very different scales side by side: Astir of Paros with 57 rooms (46 suites and 11 doubles) for a guest block under one roof, and Akti Paros with a 350-guest reception hall but only seven apartments, so a large Akti wedding needs guest rooms elsewhere around Naoussa.

Monastiri sits about a 10-minute drive from Naoussa beside the Monastiri of Saint Ioannis Detis and has its own dock, so guests staying in Naoussa can arrive by road or by boat; it has no rooms, so plan return transport at the end of the night.

Anemoi is the only batch A venue with its own chapel on site (Chapel of St. John) and a poolside reception area facing the Aegean, which keeps ceremony and reception in one place; with eight apartments it suits a small wedding party with most guests staying in Naoussa.

Capacity figures published in the north are not wedding figures: Astir's 130 is conference seating and Monastiri's 800 is amphitheatre seating for corporate events. Only Akti publishes a reception figure (350). Ask every venue for seated dinner and ceremony numbers separately.

open_questions.question: Batch A qualifies 4 in Naoussa and the north: Astir of Paros (five-star, Kolymbithres), Anemoi Paros Hotel Resort (Naoussa, on-site chapel), Monastiri Beach Bar & Restaurant (Agios Ioannis Detis, beach ceremonies, no rooms) and Akti Paros (Kolymbithres, 350-guest reception hall, seven apartments, family-run, not luxury). Include Akti or hold as reserve?
